verdict.rationale: Running an operating system headlessly or on CI runners is a fair axis for macOS, but the evidence never documents headless operation or CI use. Shortcuts automation (macos-docs-19) is an adjacent GUI automation feature. Community mentions of built-in command-line tools (pbcopy, qlmanage) show terminal utilities, not headless or CI execution of the OS.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
